method: Image inspection of six paired real-device captures, one per format/layout; remaining captures are not individually visually certified.
observations: Inspected states preserve page order, corner direction and broadly similar silhouettes.
No obvious missing page, major geometry break or mirroring regression in inspected pairs.
Mesh contact/cast shadows are narrower; shader has broader, softer analytical shading.
Mesh and shader differ in text sampling and edge coverage; not pixel-equivalent.
limitations: Static phase spot checks, not a motion-quality or frame-by-frame study.
No Apple Books reference capture or visual parity acceptance.
Native OS cancellation and long-duration memory stability remain unverified.
Original book captures remain private and are excluded from repository results.
recommendation: Use mesh as the leading iOS prototype candidate on this tested 60 Hz device; investigate first-drag cold outlier and refine lighting before production adoption. Android renderer choice remains independently evaluated.
